department: Smith School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog deadline is December 15; complete applications received by January 7 are automatically considered for financial aid.

also.quote: Completed applications and all accompanying online materials received by January 7 will be automatically considered for financial aid.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Students do at least two rotations and are matched to a group by the Director of Graduate Studies.
supervisor.quote: All Ph.D. students complete at least two rotations before matching with a research group.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students get a full tuition waiver, stipend and health insurance; nine-month stipends, summer support usually available.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the Ph.D. program receive full financial aid in the form of a full tuition waiver, stipend, and health insurance, either from a fellowship, research assistantship, or teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: Most applicants have an accredited-equivalent undergraduate chemical engineering background; chemistry, materials, microbiology and physics majors are also encouraged.
entry_route.quote: Most applicants have satisfactorily completed the equivalent of the fundamental work required by an accredited curriculum in chemical engineering.

name: Chemical Engineering
